description_en: Updates the configuration of a knowledge base build task without changing the input and configuration snapshots of created instances
description_zh: 更新知识库构建任务的配置，不改变已创建实例的输入与配置快照
name: UpdateKnowledgeBaseBuildTask

parameters.help_en: The workspace used for future runs
parameters.help_zh: 以后运行所用的工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

fields.help_en: The metadata entity ID returned by Data Map. The client must pass this value as is and must not concatenate database, schema, or table identifiers
fields.help_zh: 数据地图返回的元数据实体 ID；客户端原样传递，不自行拼接数据库、Schema 或表标识
fields.name: entity_id

fields.help_en: The entity level, such as DATABASE, SCHEMA, or TABLE. The server validates this value based on the Data Map identity. The presence of an enum value does not guarantee that all engines support it
fields.help_zh: 实体层级，如 DATABASE、SCHEMA、TABLE；服务端以数据地图身份校验，不因枚举存在就承诺所有引擎均支持
fields.name: entity_type

fields.help_en: The Data Map entities such as databases, schemas, and tables selected for data asset-scoped builds. The list cannot be empty and must contain unique values
fields.help_zh: 数据资产范围构建选择的数据库、Schema、表等数据地图实体；非空、去重
fields.name: entities

fields.help_en: Required when building from document objects in this knowledge base. The list cannot be empty and must contain unique values. Each item is a KnowledgeObjectId with Type=DOCUMENT in this knowledge base. Do not mix this with SourceIds for external connector synchronization scopes
fields.help_zh: 从本库文档对象构建时必填、非空且去重；每项为本库 Type=DOCUMENT 的 KnowledgeObjectId；与外部连接器同步范围 SourceIds 不混用
fields.name: knowledge_object_ids

fields.help_en: The DataWorks workspace IDs selected for workspace-scoped builds. The list cannot be empty and must contain unique values
fields.help_zh: 工作空间范围构建选择的 DataWorks 工作空间 ID；非空、去重
fields.name: project_ids

fields.help_en: The IDs of registered sources in this knowledge base. The list must contain unique values. Whether this parameter is required and the allowed source types depend on the task input scenario. See the following table
fields.help_zh: 本库已登记来源的 ID，去重；是否必填及允许的来源类型由任务输入场景决定，见下表
fields.name: source_ids

fields.help_en: The YAML upload session ID in this knowledge base used for SEMANTIC_MODEL import tasks. This ID is bound when the task is created and cannot be mixed with other input scopes
fields.help_zh: SEMANTIC_MODEL 导入任务使用的本库 YAML 上传会话 ID；创建任务时绑定，不能混用其他输入范围
fields.name: yaml_upload_id

parameters.help_en: The input configuration that completely replaces the original input
parameters.name: input

fields.help_en: The DataWorks scheduling cron expression. This parameter is provided only when Mode is set to PERIODIC
fields.help_zh: 仅 PERIODIC 提供；DataWorks 调度 Cron 表达式
fields.name: cron

fields.help_en: Specifies whether periodic automatic triggering is enabled. This parameter is provided only when Mode is set to PERIODIC. This parameter does not indicate the instance status
fields.help_zh: 仅 PERIODIC 提供；控制周期自动触发的启停，不是实例状态
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The trigger mode. Valid values: MANUAL and PERIODIC. Manual tasks do not create instances automatically
fields.help_zh: MANUAL 或 PERIODIC；手动任务不自动创建实例
fields.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The trigger configuration that completely replaces the original trigger
parameters.name: trigger

fields.help_en: The compute specifications of the Builder. Valid values: 4 to 16. If this parameter is omitted during creation, the valid value is 4. The read operation returns the valid value
fields.help_zh: Builder 计算规格，取值 4～16；创建省略时有效值为 4，读取返回有效值
fields.name: cu

fields.help_en: The DataWorks resource group ID used by the actual Builder node. The server validates that it is available in the workspace corresponding to the top-level ProjectId of the task
fields.help_zh: 真实 Builder 节点使用的 DataWorks 资源组 ID；服务端校验其在任务顶层 ProjectId 对应工作空间内可用
fields.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: Updates the runtime resources based on the submitted fields. If ResourceGroupId or Cu is not provided, the original value is retained
parameters.help_zh: 按提交字段更新运行资源；未传 ResourceGroupId 或 Cu 保持原值
parameters.name: runtime_resource

parameters.help_en: The specific model ID or AUTO
parameters.help_zh: 具体模型 ID 或 AUTO
parameters.name: llm_model

Code.description_en: The business error code, which is used to determine the error type when the request fails
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码；请求失败时用于判断错误类型

Data.description_en: The business data returned when the request is successful
Data.description_zh: 成功时返回的业务数据

ContentLocale.description_en: The content language of this task. This parameter is optional and is explicitly selected when the task is created
ContentLocale.description_zh: 本任务内容语言，可选；由任务创建时明确选择

Description.description_en: The task description. This parameter is optional

Input.description_en: The input scope specified based on the task type
Input.description_zh: 按任务 Type 指定的输入范围

Entities.description_en: The Data Map entities such as databases, schemas, and tables selected for data asset-scoped builds. The list cannot be empty and must contain unique values
Entities.description_zh: 数据资产范围构建选择的数据库、Schema、表等数据地图实体；非空、去重

EntityId.description_en: The metadata entity ID returned by Data Map. The client must pass this value as is and must not concatenate database, schema, or table identifiers
EntityId.description_zh: 数据地图返回的元数据实体 ID；客户端原样传递，不自行拼接数据库、Schema 或表标识

EntityType.description_en: The entity level, such as DATABASE, SCHEMA, or TABLE. The server validates this value based on the Data Map identity. The presence of an enum value does not guarantee that all engines support it
EntityType.description_zh: 实体层级，如 DATABASE、SCHEMA、TABLE；服务端以数据地图身份校验，不因枚举存在就承诺所有引擎均支持

KnowledgeObjectIds.description_en: Required when building from document objects in this knowledge base. The list cannot be empty and must contain unique values. Each item is a KnowledgeObjectId with Type=DOCUMENT in this knowledge base. Do not mix this with SourceIds for external connector synchronization scopes
KnowledgeObjectIds.description_zh: 从本库文档对象构建时必填、非空且去重；每项为本库 Type=DOCUMENT 的 KnowledgeObjectId；与外部连接器同步范围 SourceIds 不混用

items.description_en: Required when building from document objects in this knowledge base. The list cannot be empty and must contain unique values. Each item is a KnowledgeObjectId with Type=DOCUMENT in this knowledge base. Do not mix this with SourceIds for external connector synchronization scopes
items.description_zh: 从本库文档对象构建时必填、非空且去重；每项为本库 Type=DOCUMENT 的 KnowledgeObjectId；与外部连接器同步范围 SourceIds 不混用

ProjectIds.description_en: The DataWorks workspace IDs selected for workspace-scoped builds. The list cannot be empty and must contain unique values
ProjectIds.description_zh: 工作空间范围构建选择的 DataWorks 工作空间 ID；非空、去重

items.description_en: The DataWorks workspace IDs selected for workspace-scoped builds. The list cannot be empty and must contain unique values
items.description_zh: 工作空间范围构建选择的 DataWorks 工作空间 ID；非空、去重

SourceIds.description_en: The IDs of registered sources in this knowledge base. The list must contain unique values. Whether this parameter is required and the allowed source types depend on the task input scenario. See the following table
SourceIds.description_zh: 本库已登记来源的 ID，去重；是否必填及允许的来源类型由任务输入场景决定，见下表

items.description_en: The IDs of registered sources in this knowledge base. The list must contain unique values. Whether this parameter is required and the allowed source types depend on the task input scenario. See the following table
items.description_zh: 本库已登记来源的 ID，去重；是否必填及允许的来源类型由任务输入场景决定，见下表

YamlUploadId.description_en: The YAML upload session ID in this knowledge base used for SEMANTIC_MODEL import tasks. This ID is bound when the task is created and cannot be mixed with other input scopes
YamlUploadId.description_zh: SEMANTIC_MODEL 导入任务使用的本库 YAML 上传会话 ID；创建任务时绑定，不能混用其他输入范围

LlmModel.description_en: The specific model ID or AUTO configured for tasks that require a model. If this parameter is omitted during creation, it is equivalent to AUTO. This parameter is not configured for tasks that do not call a model
LlmModel.description_zh: 需要模型的任务可配置具体模型 ID 或 AUTO；创建时省略等价于 AUTO，不调用模型的任务不配置

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the definition was last modified

ProjectId.description_en: The DataWorks workspace ID where the task runs. This is different from the build asset scope specified by Input.ProjectIds
ProjectId.description_zh: 任务运行所在的 DataWorks 工作空间 ID；不同于 Input.ProjectIds 指定的构建资产范围

RuntimeResource.description_en: The task runtime resource group and Builder compute specifications
RuntimeResource.description_zh: 任务运行资源组及 Builder 计算规格

Cu.description_en: The compute specifications of the Builder. Valid values: 4 to 16. If this parameter is omitted during creation, the valid value is 4. The read operation returns the valid value
Cu.description_zh: Builder 计算规格，取值 4～16；创建省略时有效值为 4，读取返回有效值

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The DataWorks resource group ID used by the actual Builder node. The server validates that it is available in the workspace corresponding to the top-level ProjectId of the task
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 真实 Builder 节点使用的 DataWorks 资源组 ID；服务端校验其在任务顶层 ProjectId 对应工作空间内可用

Trigger.description_en: The manual or periodic trigger configuration

Cron.description_en: The DataWorks scheduling cron expression. This parameter is provided only when Mode is set to PERIODIC
Cron.description_zh: 仅 PERIODIC 提供；DataWorks 调度 Cron 表达式

Enabled.description_en: Specifies whether periodic automatic triggering is enabled. This parameter is provided only when Mode is set to PERIODIC. This parameter does not indicate the instance status
Enabled.description_zh: 仅 PERIODIC 提供；控制周期自动触发的启停，不是实例状态

Mode.description_en: The trigger mode. Valid values: MANUAL and PERIODIC. Manual tasks do not create instances automatically
Mode.description_zh: MANUAL 或 PERIODIC；手动任务不自动创建实例

Type.description_en: The task type. Valid values: PROJECT_SPACE_BUILD, SEMANTIC_GRAPH, DOCUMENT_GRAPH, DOCUMENT_SYNC, DOCUMENT_SYNC_AND_GRAPH, and SEMANTIC_MODEL. SEMANTIC_MODEL is used only for YAML import
Type.description_zh: 任务类型：PROJECT_SPACE_BUILD、SEMANTIC_GRAPH、DOCUMENT_GRAPH、DOCUMENT_SYNC、DOCUMENT_SYNC_AND_GRAPH、SEMANTIC_MODEL；SEMANTIC_MODEL 仅用于 YAML 导入

Message.description_en: The secure error message returned when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 请求失败时的安全错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
